snippet.title: Hell Architect Survivors - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
What if Hell was your next construction project?

Hell Architect Survivors is a darkly comedic action roguelite where you rise through the ranks of Hell, defeat Lucifer, and rebuild the underworld your way.

Harness forbidden powers, recruit damned souls, and survive endless infernal hordes.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128960/Hell_Architect_Survivors/

🔥 About the Game

😈 Roguelite Chaos
• Face endless waves of enemies
• Build powerful and chaotic synergies

⚔️ Infernal Combat
• Use cursed weapons and forbidden abilities
• Create absurd and powerful builds

🏗️ Rise Through Hell
• Climb the infernal hierarchy
• Prove your vision to rebuild the underworld

👥 Unique Characters
• Play as historical and mythological figures
• Each with unique abilities and playstyles

🧠 Strategic Progression
• Adapt your build every run
• Survive increasingly difficult encounters

🌀 Dark Humor
• A satirical take on Hell and its systems
• Absurd powers and over-the-top mechanics
